title: IgnorePreviouslyPickedEntities (spell flag)
html:
IgnorePreviouslyPickedEntities is a spell flag. For spells and other actions that can select multiple targets, this flag determines whether those targets must be distinct. For example,  Scorching Ray does not have this flag which means all of its rays can be targeted at the same creature. On the other hand,  Command has this flag so a single target cannot be selected twice when upcast.

In general, multi-target damaging actions like Scorching Ray are not restricted with this flag, while multi-target control spells like Command are. However, there are some exceptions such as upcasted  Blindness or  Slow (but only when cast at level 4). For these spells, a single target can be chosen multiple times, forcing it to make multiple saving throws against the effect.

While not specifically related to this flag, all spells cast with  Metamagic: Twinned Spell are similarly restricted to targeting distinct creatures.
